messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] rhipe with hortonworks hadoop
parts:
There shouldn't be a reason why it wont work with HortonWorks, though i wouldn't surprised if some changes would be required.
For example, RHIPE doesn't seem to work with stock apache hadoop because of one API call! This api calls makes it work with CDH clusters. I'm sure there is a simple work around but since I work with CDH clusters (and i think Ryan too), we test against CDH.

If you're a developer, we can assist in fixing bugs.
